verdict.rationale: cubic applies some actions across many items at once: it automatically reviews every new PR, codebase scans run thousands of agents across a whole repository, and custom agents or cubic.yaml enforce rules across all PRs. Its MCP server also lets a coding agent triage PR and codebase-scan issues. None of this is documented as a user-driven bulk operation over a selected set of items; fixes are described as one-click per finding, and no public API spec was found. Missing for 10: explicit bulk actions (e.g., batch triage, dismiss or fix many findings, re-review many PRs at once), a documented batch API or OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
